summary: Support-access findings go to Invardia support only, and the web app keeps only the rights it needs.

fixes.title: Support-access findings stay with support
fixes.text: When an update finds extra support access, it now reports it to Invardia support instead of mailing your admins. You are mailed only when PIM actually removes a right.

fixes.title: Fewer rights for the web app
fixes.text: The web app no longer needs any directory read rights. An old support step that needed extra rights is retired, and a key reference is no longer reported as a secret.
